title: FSM-Bench-20: Local LLM Benchmark for Deterministic FSM Generation
description: Reproducible benchmark of 20 natural-language requirement specifications for evaluating open-weight LLMs on guarded finite-state machine generation under local Ollama inference. The public replication package includes the dataset, prompt specification, schema, evaluator, conservative guard-aware determinism (M0–M3), criterion freeze, unit tests, campaign manifests, aggregate metrics summaries, and per-group diagnostics for the frozen 140-run campaign (manifest 20260602T195520Z). Full per-pair CSV records and raw/cleaned model outputs are size-excluded from the public archive.
